[01_plan_overview#6]
Your Essential Plus plan: overview. When cover starts. Most treatment has a waiting period after you join. See "Waiting periods".

[04_waiting_periods#1]
Waiting periods. When you first join, there is a waiting period of 182 days from the date your cover began. Treatment in the first 182 days is not covered. Treatment on day 182 or later is covered, subject to the usual limits.

[04_waiting_periods#5]
Waiting periods. What the accident exception does and does not do. It removes the waiting period only. Every other requirement still applies: you still need an itemised receipt, any referral or pre-authorisation the treatment needs, and the amount must be within the limit.
